title: Data Engineer
audience: Engineers building reliable, governed data platforms and pipelines.
description: Progress from programming and database fundamentals through modeling, batch/stream processing, distributed systems, cloud, orchestration, quality, security, and serving.

source_analysis: PDF coverage: lifecycle, programming, SQL/NoSQL, modeling, warehouses/lakes/mesh, cloud, batch/stream ETL, Airflow/dbt, Hadoop/Spark, Docker/Kubernetes, CI/CD, tests/monitoring, Kafka/RabbitMQ/SQS/SNS, IaC, BI/reverse ETL, security, governance and quality.
analysis_method: Extracted labels from the one-page source PDF and visually reviewed the rendered roadmap layout; regrouped prerequisites into a sequential learning path and expanded topics for practical projects and production work.
learning_sequence: Follow stages and nodes in order. Optional specialization can be revisited after the capstone.
